personalities.name: Night Owl
personalities.description: Loves late nights, quiet vibes, stargazing, and deep talks at 2 AM. Energy peaks after dark.

personalities.name: Early Bird
personalities.description: Enjoys mornings, fresh starts, sunrise walks, and coffee before the world wakes up. Optimistic and energetic in the day.

personalities.name: Wanderer
personalities.description: Loves exploring places, spontaneous plans, travel, and discovering hidden spots. Thrives on adventure.

personalities.name: Homebody
personalities.description: Prefers staying in, cozy vibes, movies, books, and comfort over chaos. Introverted but nurturing.

personalities.name: Creator
personalities.description: Passionate about music, art, writing, or content creation. Expresses emotions through creativity.

personalities.name: Hustler
personalities.description: Always chasing goals, gym, work, or side hustles. Motivated, ambitious, and disciplined.
